papers.title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
papers.translated_title: 基于可变粒度的图像到三维部件生成统一框架
papers.author: Qiwen Gu
papers.summary: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart
papers.translated_summary: 可控三维部件生成对数字资产生成至关重要，然而现有方法缺乏灵活性，难以适应需要不同控制程度的多样化用户工作流。本文提出FlexPart，一个统一的图像到三维部件生成框架，在单一模型中支持可变粒度的几何条件。通过门控自适应调制无缝集成从稀疏点到密集边界框和掩码的异构输入，FlexPart实现了强大的跨模态协同。我们还提出了一种非对称几何引导机制，利用强空间先验来对齐跨粒度的表示，提升几何一致性并促进任务间协同。在PartVerseXL上以掩码为条件时，FlexPart相较于TripoSG + SAM3D将部件CD降低了16.6%，相较于OmniPart降低了10.5%，同时保持具有竞争力的整体网格质量。代码可在https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart获取。

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.translated_title: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理
papers.author: Yunfei Xie
papers.summary: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.
papers.translated_summary: 机器人基础模型通常通过昂贵的闭环部署进行评估，这促使人们寻求廉价的离线代理指标来衡量模型能力。柏拉图表示假说（PRH）表明，随着表示能力的提升，视觉和语言等不同模态会趋同于一个共享的现实统计模型。我们追问运动轨迹是否构成另一种此类模态：随着具身模型能力增强，其感官表示是否应向物理运动的结构收敛？为考察这一问题，我们提出感觉运动对齐（$S^2$），一种无需训练的离线指标，用于衡量模型的感官表示与物理运动几何结构的对齐程度。我们发现，$S^2$ 在各类具身模型家族中与下游机器人任务成功率呈正相关，使其成为在闭环评估之前优先筛选模型的低成本离线代理指标。$S^2$ 还能在昂贵的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）微调之前，识别出有前景的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干网络。除相关性之外，$S^2$ 还为 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）中观察到的现象提供了表示层面的解释。借助 $S^2$，我们将 PRH 扩展到具身模型，并使感觉运动对齐在经验上可测量，为理解具身模型为何能超越其闭环成功率而取得成功提供了洞见。

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.translated_title: 通过视频阅读、写作、分享和与世界互动
papers.author: Shengqiong Wu
papers.summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
papers.translated_summary: 视频基础模型在理解和生成视觉序列方面已取得快速进展，而视频世界模型则试图捕捉其所描绘世界的底层动态。尽管目标不同，两者都关注视频观测与一个演化世界之间的关系。本综述采用世界建模作为审视这些发展的统一视角。将观测到的视频视为一个潜在时间世界的部分、有损且按时间排序的投影，我们围绕四个互补操作来组织文献：读取从观测视频中推断世界属性；写入根据指定或学习到的世界条件合成视频；共享通过共同的建模机制整合理解与生成；交互在动作和演化观测下预测并更新世界状态。这一视角将观测或生成序列中的时间连贯性与底层世界状态的一致性区分开来。在任务、表示、模型、数据集和基准方面，我们追踪到重心的转变：从片段级识别和感知保真度转向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性，以及基于交互和下游决策的评估，并提炼出随之而来的开放挑战。

papers.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
papers.translated_title: 面向思维剪枝的直接Pass@$k$优化：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
papers.author: Mahdi Salmani
papers.summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
papers.translated_summary: 测试时扩展已成为推理模型的一种关键推理策略，模型通过生成大量候选解，以期至少找到其中一个正确解。将所有候选解运行至完成可能在计算上代价高昂，因此近期工作在仅生成较短前缀后便对候选池进行剪枝，只对存活的候选继续投入计算。现有剪枝策略大致分为两类：基于质量的方法为每个部分解分配分数，并丢弃那些被预测最终会导致错误最终解的候选；而基于多样性的方法则选择遵循不同推理轨迹、因而可能覆盖不同最终解的部分解。这两个目标之间的张力是探索与利用的一个实例，然而此前几乎没有剪枝工作直接揭示这一权衡，更不用说对其进行优化。本文中，我们引入一种剪枝流程，通过优化所选解池上的 pass@$k$ 来直接处理这一权衡。具体而言，它选择解池以最大化如下概率：其中至少一个部分解在继续至完成后产生正确答案。由于该目标同时奖励高质量部分解并惩罚它们之间的冗余，质量与多样性由该准则本身自然平衡，而非通过单独的临时设计选择来实现。在八个开放权重推理模型上，我们的方法优于现有的基于质量和基于多样性的剪枝策略。当剪枝流程保留中等数量的部分解用于继续生成时，增益尤为显著，凸显了在剪枝过程中直接平衡质量与多样性的价值。

papers.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
papers.translated_title: 从随机特征到完全可训练网络的相变
papers.author: Xin He
papers.summary: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adaptive representations. This paper quantifies a phase transition pattern in approximation bounds and observes analogous behavior in training errors: a rapid but smooth initial improvement followed by diminishing returns, with a sharper transition under greater initialization mismatch. Under polynomial spectral decay with exponent $α>1$ and leverage compatibility, we establish a squared $L_2$ approximation rate $\mathcal{O}((κ_P\log(m/δ)/m)^α)$ for two-layer networks of width $m$ and trainable proportion $P$, where $κ_P=(P/κ_1^*+(1-P)/κ_0^*)^{-1}$. The bound holds uniformly over the unit ball of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with probability at least $1-δ$. The constants $κ_0^*$ and $κ_1^*$ quantify the fixed and trainable groups' sampling mismatches relative to the target RKHS. For spherical biased-ReLU features in dimension $d$, we verify these assumptions with $α=(d+2)/(d-1)$ and $κ_0^*=4\sqrt{2}τ(d+1)/d$ for initialization scale $τ\ge1$, and $κ_1^*=1$ under ridge leverage sampling. For $d=5$ and $τ=10$, a trainable proportion of approximately $4.1\%$ captures $90\%$ of the reduction in the approximation bound from $P=0$ to $P=1$. A structured three-layer example illustrates how a few trainable first-layer neurons exploit fixed downstream blocks through nonlinear composition. Numerical experiments across diverse settings, including networks with up to 15 layers, exhibit similar phase transitions in training errors.
papers.translated_summary: 构造精确且计算上可行的近似空间是科学计算中的一项基本任务。部分可训练神经网络将固定随机特征与完全自适应表示相结合。本文量化了近似界中的相变模式，并在训练误差中观察到类似行为：初始阶段快速但平滑的改善，随后收益递减，且在初始化失配更大时转变更为急剧。在谱衰减指数为 $α>1$ 的多项式谱衰减和杠杆兼容性条件下，我们为宽度为 $m$、可训练比例为 $P$ 的两层网络建立了平方 $L_2$ 近似速率 $\mathcal{O}((κ_P\log(m/δ)/m)^α)$，其中 $κ_P=(P/κ_1^*+(1-P)/κ_0^*)^{-1}$。该界在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的单位球上一致成立，概率至少为 $1-δ$。常数 $κ_0^*$ 和 $κ_1^*$ 量化了固定组和可训练组相对于目标 RKHS 的采样失配。对于维度为 $d$ 的球面偏置 ReLU 特征，我们在初始化尺度 $τ\ge1$ 下以 $α=(d+2)/(d-1)$ 和 $κ_0^*=4\sqrt{2}τ(d+1)/d$ 验证了这些假设，并在岭杠杆采样下得到 $κ_1^*=1$。对于 $d=5$ 和 $τ=10$，约 $4.1\%$ 的可训练比例即可捕获从 $P=0$ 到 $P=1$ 近似界缩减量的 $90\%$。一个结构化的三层示例说明了少量可训练的第一层神经元如何通过非线性复合利用固定的下游模块。在包括多达 15 层网络在内的多种设置下的数值实验，在训练误差中表现出类似的相变。

papers.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
papers.translated_title: 通过选择性审计实现可靠的AI辅助决策
papers.author: Isaac Gibbs
papers.summary: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthiness of the decision. The decision and confidence score need not be produced by the same model: for example, one agent may propose a decision, while a separate verifier agent evaluates it and outputs a correctness or safety score. Based on this information, we must decide whether to accept the AI decision automatically or consult an expert, such as a human auditor, who reviews the proposal and either accepts or corrects it. We formulate this task as an online constrained optimization problem in which the goal is to minimize the frequency of expert auditing while guaranteeing that the fraction of AI errors that go unaudited stays below a user-defined threshold. We derive a family of algorithms with provable error-control guarantees with no assumptions, including a method that is optimally efficient: it asymptotically attains the best achievable auditing rate for both adversarial and i.i.d. data streams. Experiments on screening harmful requests to large language models, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling show that our methods achieve valid error control in practice while substantially reducing the need for human auditing compared to baselines.
papers.translated_summary: 我们考虑对一个产生一系列决策的AI系统进行在线监测。在每一轮中，系统输出一个建议决策以及一个估计该决策可信度的置信分数。决策和置信分数不必由同一模型产生：例如，一个智能体可以提出决策，而另一个独立的验证器智能体对其进行评估并输出正确性或安全性分数。基于这些信息，我们必须决定是自动接受AI决策，还是咨询专家，例如人工审核员，由其审查该建议并接受或纠正它。我们将此任务形式化为一个在线约束优化问题，其目标是在保证未经审核的AI错误比例保持在用户定义阈值以下的同时，最小化专家审核的频率。我们推导出一族具有可证明错误控制保证且无需任何假设的算法，其中包括一种最优高效的方法：对于对抗性和独立同分布数据流，它渐近地达到可实现的最佳审核率。在筛选对大型语言模型的有害请求、定性文本标注和数据标注上的实验表明，我们的方法在实践中实现了有效的错误控制，同时与基线相比大幅减少了人工审核的需求。

papers.title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
papers.translated_title: SpectralCanary：用于T2I数据集使用审计的极其简单的低频痕迹
papers.author: Sy-Tuyen Ho
papers.summary: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model's generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce $\textbf{SpectralCanary}$, which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR ($91.1\%$) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ($94.8\%$) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages $92.4\%$ per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM $0.989$, LPIPS $0.022$) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean $Δ$FID $0.05$) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than $25$ $Δ$FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.
papers.translated_summary: 审计一个文本到图像（T2I）模型是否在特定图像集合上进行了微调是困难的：模型可以吸收集合级别的视觉特征，而不复制训练图像。主动式数据集使用审计在数据集发布前植入一个共享信号，随后检查该信号是否出现在可疑模型的生成输出中。现有方法往往在可验证性、保真度、鲁棒性和可部署性之间权衡。我们提出$\textbf{SpectralCanary}$，它使用平滑的低通掩码将固定的金丝雀图像混合到每张集合图像中，同时保持caption不变，且既不需要辅助生成也不需要逐图像优化。一个轻量级验证器在可疑模型的输出中检测迁移的信号。在Pokemon数据集上的八项测试和三种真实数据变换中，跨越两个架构家族，SpectralCanary在所评估的方法中取得了最高的平均逐代TPR@$1\%$ FPR（$91.1\%$）以及使用30次生成的固定阈值模型级准确率（$94.8\%$）。在涵盖艺术、医学、卫星和时尚领域的五个数据集上使用SD3.5，SpectralCanary平均达到$92.4\%$的逐代TPR@$1\%$ FPR，同时保持发布图像的质量（SSIM $0.989$，LPIPS $0.022$），各数据集的平均变化FID接近零（平均$Δ$FID $0.05$）。在Pokemon和ROCOv2上的匹配能量消融支持了我们的设计选择，低频放置相比中/高频放置能更可靠地迁移。在所评估的自适应攻击下，最有效的移除需要激进的修改并产生超过$25$个$Δ$FID点。这些结果确认了低频视觉信号作为集合级T2I审计痕迹的有效载体。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
papers.translated_title: 基于LLM的IT工单分类中的成本感知弃权机制
papers.author: Sachin Gupta
papers.summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
papers.translated_summary: IT支持工单的错误自动路由可能比人工分诊代价更高。我们将成本感知弃权评估为一种离线、成本条件化的就绪性评估：在显式成本下于校准数据上选择路由策略，然后在留出测试数据上对该冻结策略进行一次评估。在一个包含47,837张工单、八个类别的公开语料库上，我们在零样本和少样本提示下比较了四个训练过的非LLM分类器与四个大语言模型。在示例性成本模型(c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5)下，TF-IDF配合逻辑回归以及在校准集上选定的0.60阈值将测试成本从0.763降至0.472，相对降低38.1%（配对比率自助法95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]），同时将错误路由从15.3%降至3.5%。在事后成本参数分析中，冻结的校准选定策略在16种设置中的14种里于留出测试数据上同时优于始终路由和始终延迟。最强的提示配置在分层1,000张工单测试子集上达到0.477准确率，而同一批工单上微调DistilBERT为0.879。等渗回归降低了期望校准误差，但未可靠改善区分度：GPT-4o-mini少样本在校准前后各只有一个置信度值，正确性AUROC为0.500。因此，我们在报告ECE的同时报告正确性AUROC和并列感知的风险-覆盖率面积。在解析推导的盈亏平衡概率0.80处，七个提示配置延迟所有工单；Haiku少样本仅路由19/1,000。仅LLM一致性对照和边际/熵拒绝基线进一步将校准与区分度分开。研究结果受限于该数据集、提示设计、模型端点和示例性成本；本工作是评估框架，而非新的弃权算法或通用部署认证。

papers.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.translated_title: METTA：面向元强化学习的记忆增强测试时适应
papers.author: Ali Najar
papers.summary: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, METTA achieves a success rate over $50\%$ while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that METTA provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.
papers.translated_summary: 元强化学习旨在训练智能体能够从有限交互中快速适应未见任务，但这需要在长交互历史中表征任务证据。经典循环智能体将经验压缩为隐状态，而基于Transformer的智能体则以二次方的内存和计算成本从过去轨迹中检索。在本工作中，我们提出面向元强化学习的内存增强测试时适应（METTA）。它将快速适应阶段分解为两个时间尺度：因果神经内存以线性序列复杂度执行细粒度的回合内适应，而紧凑的回合级摘要支持长程跨回合任务推断，无需关注完整交互历史。此外，为智能体配备神经内存提供了充分的表达能力和测试时训练能力，使其能够在元测试时有效适应未见的留出任务和任务族。在未见的留出Meta-World ML10/45测试环境中，METTA在保持低训练预算和短实际运行时间的同时，成功率超过50%。在长上下文稀疏奖励PointMaze任务上，它通过表现出更有结构的探索行为而优于基于Transformer的基线。这些结果表明，METTA为更具适应性和可扩展性的长上下文元强化学习提供了一条高效路径。

papers.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
papers.translated_title: BrickWright：物理可行积木搭建的智能体式创作
papers.author: Ava Pun
papers.summary: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/
papers.translated_summary: 前沿编码智能体在3D建模方面正变得越来越熟练。然而，在构建需要在物理世界中组装的物体时，它们仍面临挑战，常常生成无效的装配体，出现悬浮、碰撞或断开的部分。我们认为，为智能体提供用于组装构建和验证其物理可行性的工具，就足以让它们生成物理上有效且仍符合输入提示的装配体。聚焦于乐高积木构建领域，我们提出了BrickWright，一个利用预训练智能体从文本或图像提示生成物理可行积木构建的框架，其中构建在仅使用真实零件、没有碰撞或悬浮零件、并在可能时形成连通结构的情况下是物理可行的。BrickWright引导智能体通过使用BrickLayer编写代码来创建构建，BrickLayer是一个Python工具包，包含两个主要组件：一个符合人体工程学的积木组装API，与在原始LDraw中工作相比可将推理成本减半；以及一个提供物理可行性反馈的验证器。基线智能体的物理有效性率仅从9%（GPT-6 Luna）到69%（GPT-6 Astra）不等，而BrickWright引导的智能体在512个提示样本上达到100%的有效性，同时改善了轻量级智能体的提示遵循度，并保持了较强智能体的提示遵循度。此外，它们在文本到积木任务上优于专用模型。代码可在我们的项目页面获取：https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/

papers.title: Testing The Protective Function of Flash Coloration Using Wild Avian Predators
papers.translated_title: 测试闪光色在野生鸟类捕食者中的保护功能
papers.author: Brown, T.
papers.summary: Many prey reveal conspicuous color patches during movement that become concealed when they stop. Such abrupt changes in appearance have been proposed to disrupt predator tracking and make prey more difficult to relocate, providing the basis of the flash coloration hypothesis. However, empirical support remains inconsistent and comes largely from experiments using human observers or simplified artificial prey. Here, we used touchscreen-equipped operant chambers to test the flash coloration hypothesis with wild blue tits (Cyanistes caeruleus) searching for moving digital prey modelled on Catocala moths. The digital prey revealed either conspicuous or cryptic hindwings during flight before adopting a cryptic resting appearance. Contrary to predictions, conspicuous hindwings neither increased prey survival nor delayed prey relocation compared to moths with cryptic hindwings. However, conspicuous hindwings also did not incur detectable predation costs. In contrast, background strongly affected prey detection, with moths surviving better on realistic bark than on smooth grey backgrounds. Our results provide no evidence that conspicuous colors revealed during movement enhance prey survival in this context, suggesting that any protective effect attributed to flash coloration may be weak or strongly dependent on ecological conditions.
papers.translated_summary: 许多猎物在移动时会显露出醒目的色斑，而一旦停止便将其隐藏。这种外观上的突然变化被认为能够干扰捕食者的追踪，使猎物更难被重新定位，从而构成了闪色假说的基础。然而，实证支持仍不一致，且主要来自使用人类观察者或简化人工猎物的实验。在此，我们使用配备触摸屏的操作性条件反射箱，以野生蓝山雀（Cyanistes caeruleus）为实验对象，测试闪色假说，让它们搜寻模仿Catocala蛾类的移动数字猎物。数字猎物在飞行过程中显露醒目或隐蔽的后翅，随后采取隐蔽的静止外观。与预测相反，与具有隐蔽后翅的蛾类相比，醒目的后翅既未提高猎物存活率，也未延迟猎物的重新定位。然而，醒目的后翅也未产生可检测的捕食代价。相比之下，背景强烈影响猎物检测，蛾类在逼真的树皮背景上比在光滑灰色背景上存活得更好。我们的结果未提供证据表明在此情境下移动过程中显露的醒目颜色能提高猎物存活率，这表明归因于闪色的任何保护效应可能很微弱，或强烈依赖于生态条件。

papers.title: Self-extending DNA recording with stochastic and programmed writing
papers.translated_title: 具有随机和程序化写入能力的自扩展DNA记录
papers.author: Zhang, Z.
papers.summary: Recording cellular histories requires continued information accumulation while retaining earlier records. Infinite Printer couples DNA self-extension to regeneration of a writable terminal context. A single self-targeting prime-editing guide directs repeat extension, while base editing diversifies the accessible sequence in situ. A separate configuration uses auxiliary guides for specified payload writing. After three rounds of payload input, 4,436 distinct complete records contained identities from all three pools. Extended AC/AT records retained shared upstream marks, and complete-sequence readout distinguished endpoints sharing initial prefixes. Joint single-cell readout recovered 1,549 records and 7,669 combinations across 12,302 transcriptome-linked cell labels; spatial readout linked records to 11,330 capture spots. These results establish a resource for self-extending stochastic and programmed DNA recording with joint cellular and tissue readout, providing a foundation for future lineage applications.
papers.translated_summary: 记录细胞历史需要在保留早期记录的同时持续积累信息。无限打印机将DNA自我延伸与可写终端上下文再生相耦合。单个自靶向引物编辑向导引导重复延伸，而碱基编辑在原位使可访问序列多样化。另一种配置使用辅助向导写入指定有效载荷。经过三轮有效载荷输入后，4,436条不同的完整记录包含了来自全部三个池的身份信息。延伸的AC/AT记录保留了共享的上游标记，完整序列读取区分了共享初始前缀的端点。联合单细胞读取在12,302个转录组关联细胞标签中回收了1,549条记录和7,669种组合；空间读取将记录关联到11,330个捕获点。这些结果建立了一个用于自延伸随机和程序化DNA记录的资源，具备联合细胞和组织读取能力，为未来的谱系应用提供了基础。

papers.title: Metabolic blueprints of monocultures enable prediction and design of synthetic microbial consortia
papers.translated_title: 单培养的代谢蓝图使得合成微生物群落的预测与设计成为可能
papers.author: Bald, S.
papers.summary: Synthetic microbial ecology aims at understanding complex microbial dynamics and designing communities with desired properties, often based on mathematical models of individual organisms. However, it is unclear whether simplified models harbor enough detail to predict the composition of synthetic communities, especially in metabolically complex environments. Here, we use longitudinal exometabolite data of monocultures for 15 rhizosphere bacteria to parametrize a consumer-resource model, which we use to predict pairwise co-cultures and higher order communities. The capacity to artificially switch off cross-feeding interactions in the model demonstrates their importance in ecosystem structure. Leave-one-out and leave-two-out experiments reveal that pairwise co-cultures do not necessarily capture inter-species interactions within larger communities and broadly highlight the nonlinearity of interactions. Finally, we illustrate that our model can be used to identify new sub-communities of three strains with high likelihood of coexistence. Our results highlight experimental and theoretical challenges to be addressed in future efforts and establish hybrid mechanistic and data-driven metabolic models as a promising framework for predicting and engineering microbial communities.
papers.translated_summary: 合成微生物生态学旨在理解复杂的微生物动态并设计具有所需特性的群落，通常基于个体生物的数学模型。然而，简化模型是否包含足够的细节来预测合成群落的组成尚不清楚，尤其是在代谢复杂的环境中。在这里，我们利用15种根际细菌单培养的纵向外代谢物数据来参数化一个消费者-资源模型，并用该模型预测成对共培养和更高阶群落。在模型中人为关闭交叉喂养相互作用的能力证明了它们在生态系统结构中的重要性。留一法和留二法实验表明，成对共培养不一定能捕捉到更大群落内的种间相互作用，并广泛凸显了相互作用的非线性。最后，我们展示了我们的模型可用于识别具有高共存可能性的三菌株新亚群落。我们的结果凸显了未来工作中需要解决的实验和理论挑战，并确立了混合机理与数据驱动的代谢模型作为预测和工程化微生物群落的一个有前景的框架。

papers.title: Connexins are essential for the contribution of latent progenitors to healing after spinal cord injury
papers.translated_title: 连接蛋白对潜伏祖细胞促进脊髓损伤后愈合至关重要
papers.author: Falco, M. V.
papers.summary: Gap junctions are important regulators of the biology of neural stem cells. Both in vertebrates with regenerative abilities and neonatal rodents, ependymal cells communicate via connexin (Cx) 43 and Cx26. Gap junction coupling and Cx26 are down-regulated as the ependyma becomes quiescent in adulthood, but injury overrules this developmental down-regulation suggesting a role for Cx signaling in the reactivation of ependymal cells. However, direct evidence of the involvement of these Cxs in the reactivation of the ependymal stem cell niche is lacking. Here, we aim to explore the role of Cx26 and Cx43 in the response of ependymal cells to injury by means of specific genetic deletion. We find that Cx26 is critical for the proliferative response of ependymal cells to injury. The reduced response of ependymal cells by Cx26 deletion increased the extension of the lesion because of impaired healing resulting from a weak contribution of the ependymal stem cell niche. On the other hand, Cx43 -via gap junction coupling and hemichannels- plays a key role in the communication of Ca2+ signals between ependymal cells induced by activation of P2X7 receptors. Our data show that Cxs are relevant targets to manipulate the ependymal stem cell niche to achieve better healing after spinal cord injury.
papers.translated_summary: 缝隙连接是神经干细胞生物学的重要调控者。在具有再生能力的脊椎动物和新生啮齿动物中，室管膜细胞通过连接蛋白（connexin，Cx）43和Cx26进行通讯。随着室管膜在成年期进入静息状态，缝隙连接耦联和Cx26表达下调，但损伤可打破这一发育性下调，提示Cx信号在室管膜细胞再激活中发挥作用。然而，缺乏这些Cx参与室管膜干细胞龛再激活的直接证据。本研究旨在通过特异性基因敲除探讨Cx26和Cx43在室管膜细胞对损伤反应中的作用。我们发现Cx26对室管膜细胞对损伤的增殖反应至关重要。Cx26敲除导致的室管膜细胞反应减弱，因室管膜干细胞龛贡献不足而导致愈合受损，从而增加了病变的扩展范围。另一方面，Cx43——通过缝隙连接耦联和半通道——在P2X7受体激活诱导的室管膜细胞间Ca2+信号通讯中发挥关键作用。我们的数据表明，Cx是调控室管膜干细胞龛以实现脊髓损伤后更好愈合的相关靶点。

papers.title: Sequential coupling of sleep oscillations enables concept-neuron reactivation and supports information flow across the human hippocampal-cortical circuit
papers.translated_title: 睡眠振荡的序列耦合使概念神经元重新激活，并支持信息在人类海马-皮层回路中的流动
papers.author: Schwimmbeck, F.
papers.summary: Effective memory consolidation during sleep is thought to rely on the transfer of reactivated memory traces from the hippocampus to the cortex. However, the mechanisms supporting this essential dialogue across brain areas remain poorly understood. Here, we recorded single-neuron activity (n = 1097) in the medial temporal lobe (MTL) of 10 epilepsy patients across 21 nights of sleep. Before sleep, patients engaged in a memory task with stimuli eliciting concept-neuron responses. During non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, neuronal firing locked to sharp wave-ripples (SWR) revealed a directed flow of information from the hippocampus to cortical targets. Notably, within SWR-driven activity, experience-dependent concept neurons exhibited elevated co-activation both within and across MTL regions, indicating selective reactivation of behaviorally relevant information. Cross-regional co-activation of concept cells was markedly enhanced when hippocampal SWRs coincided with cortical slow oscillation-spindle complexes, suggesting an active role of the cortex in shaping interregional communication. These findings provide evidence that SWRs in humans selectively reactivate experience-related neural ensembles across the hippocampal-cortical network, while synergistic interactions with cortical slow oscillation-spindle events might facilitate effective memory consolidation.
papers.translated_summary: 睡眠期间有效的记忆巩固被认为依赖于重新激活的记忆痕迹从海马向皮层的转移。然而，支持这种跨脑区 essential dialogue 的机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们记录了10名癫痫患者在21个睡眠夜晚中内侧颞叶（MTL）的单神经元活动（n = 1097）。在睡眠前，患者参与了一项记忆任务，所用刺激能引发概念神经元反应。在非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠期间，与尖波涟漪（SWR）锁定的神经元放电揭示了从海马到皮层靶区的定向信息流。值得注意的是，在SWR驱动的活动中，经验依赖的概念神经元在MTL区域内及跨MTL区域均表现出升高的共激活，表明行为相关信息的选择性重激活。当海马SWR与皮层慢振荡-纺锤波复合波同时出现时，概念细胞的跨区域共激活显著增强，提示皮层在塑造区域间交流中发挥主动作用。这些发现提供了证据，表明人类的SWR能够选择性地重激活海马-皮层网络中与经验相关的神经集合，而与皮层慢振荡-纺锤波事件的协同相互作用可能促进有效的记忆巩固。

papers.title: A non-invasive approach to study localized forced in 3D epithelia
papers.translated_title: 研究三维上皮中局部作用力的非侵入性方法
papers.author: Gouirand, N.
papers.summary: Epithelial tissue integrity and remodelling rely on mechanical coupling between cytoskeletal organization and adhesion complexes, but their orchestration in three-dimensional (3D) epithelia remains unresolved. Here, we introduced a non-invasive strategy to locally probe forces within 3D epithelial tissues. We engineered elastic polyacrylamide (PAAm) microbeads with cell-like size and mechanical properties, enabling their integration into tissues. PAAm microbeads were spontaneously engulfed by the tissue, establishing an intrinsic interface. This allowed bead deformation to be directly correlated with local cytoskeletal architecture and adhesion organization, visualized through high-resolution imaging and quantitative 3D computational reconstruction. Using this approach, we demonstrated that localized mechanical perturbations trigger cytoskeletal remodelling while preserving tissue polarity. We further identified extracellular matrix composition as a key determinant of bead-tissue interactions. At the bead-cell interface, cells assembled tension-bearing focal adhesions and actin stress fibers. Quantitative analysis of bead deformation revealed sub-cellular scale patterns of cell-bead interaction forces, which correlated with the localization of cytoskeletal elements. Our findings extend previous traction force microscopy observations to 3D, revealing coordinated, spatially heterogeneous forces specifically at the cell-bead interface. Taken together, this enabled us to dissect the interplay between cellular processes and tissue mechanics in a non-invasive way in 3D model systems.
papers.translated_summary: 上皮组织的完整性和重塑依赖于细胞骨架组织与黏附复合物之间的机械耦合，但它们在三维（3D）上皮中的协调机制仍未阐明。在此，我们引入了一种非侵入性策略，用于局部探测3D上皮组织内的力。我们设计了具有细胞样尺寸和力学性质的弹性聚丙烯酰胺（PAAm）微珠，使其能够整合到组织中。PAAm微珠被组织自发吞噬，建立了内在界面。这使得微珠变形能够直接与局部细胞骨架结构和黏附组织相关联，并通过高分辨率成像和定量3D计算重建进行可视化。利用该方法，我们证明了局部机械扰动触发细胞骨架重塑，同时保持组织极性。我们进一步确定了细胞外基质组成是微珠-组织相互作用的关键决定因素。在微珠-细胞界面，细胞组装了承载张力的黏着斑和肌动蛋白应力纤维。微珠变形的定量分析揭示了细胞-微珠相互作用力的亚细胞尺度模式，这些模式与细胞骨架元件的定位相关。我们的发现将先前的牵引力显微镜观察扩展到3D，揭示了细胞-微珠界面处协调的、空间异质性的力。综上所述，这使我们能够在3D模型系统中以非侵入性方式剖析细胞过程与组织力学之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Comparative genomics of zooxanthellate and azooxanthellate Palythoa (Cnidaria: Zoantharia) provides insights into symbiosis evolution and the origin of palytoxin
papers.translated_title: 虫黄藻共生与无虫黄藻共生的沙海葵属（刺胞动物门：群体海葵目）比较基因组学研究为共生演化和岩沙海葵毒素起源提供了新见解
papers.author: Yoshioka, Y.
papers.summary: Zoantharians (Cnidaria) are globally distributed from shallow reefs to the deep sea, yet their genomic resources remain scarce. Within the zoantharian genus Palythoa, most species harbor photosymbiotic dinoflagellates, whereas some have secondarily lost this symbiosis, allowing genomic changes associated with symbiotic status to be examined. Palythoa is also the original source of palytoxin, one of the most potent marine toxins known, but whether it is produced by the host or by associated microorganisms remains unresolved. Here we generated high-quality genome assemblies of two zooxanthellate Palythoa species and compared five Palythoa genomes spanning both symbiotic states with those of other anthozoans. Across anthozoans, genome size scaled with transposable element content, particularly retrotransposons. The azooxanthellate lineage carries substitutions in conserved domains of the symbiosis-related proteins LePin and NPC2 and shows rapid evolution of the lectin gene CLEC4A, whereas NF-{kappa}B and V-type H+-ATPase remain conserved. Palythoa genomes showed no lineage-specific expansion of polyketide synthase (PKS) genes; cnidarian PKS genes were restricted to P. caribaeorum and P. sp. sakurajimensis (clade III). In contrast, 27 bacterial PKS sequences were recovered from metatranscriptomes and a metagenome-assembled genome across species, including an azooxanthellate species, indicating that they derive from associated bacterial rather than Symbiodiniaceae. These genomes provide a comparative framework for zoantharians and reveal genomic changes associated with symbiotic status. We propose that palytoxin originates from associated bacteria rather than from the host, a hypothesis that can be tested by identifying the producing bacteria and their biosynthetic gene clusters.
papers.translated_summary: Zoantharians（刺胞动物门）在全球范围内从浅水珊瑚礁到深海均有分布，然而其基因组资源仍然匮乏。在zoantharian属Palythoa中，大多数物种含有光合共生甲藻，而一些物种则次生性地失去了这种共生关系，从而使得与共生状态相关的基因组变化得以被研究。Palythoa也是palytoxin的原始来源，这是已知最强的海洋毒素之一，但其究竟由宿主还是由相关微生物产生仍未得到解决。在此，我们生成了两个含虫黄藻的Palythoa物种的高质量基因组组装，并将涵盖两种共生状态的五个Palythoa基因组与其他anthozoans进行了比较。在所有anthozoans中，基因组大小与转座元件含量呈比例关系，尤其是逆转录转座子。无虫黄藻的谱系在共生相关蛋白LePin和NPC2的保守结构域中携带替换，并显示出凝集素基因CLEC4A的快速进化，而NF-{kappa}B和V型H+-ATPase则保持保守。Palythoa基因组未显示出聚酮合酶（PKS）基因的谱系特异性扩张；刺胞动物的PKS基因仅限于P. caribaeorum和P. sp. sakurajimensis（进化枝III）。相比之下，从跨物种的宏转录组和宏基因组组装基因组中回收到了27个细菌PKS序列，包括一个无虫黄藻物种，表明它们来源于相关细菌而非Symbiodiniaceae。这些基因组为zoantharians提供了一个比较框架，并揭示了与共生状态相关的基因组变化。我们提出palytoxin来源于相关细菌而非宿主，这一假说可通过鉴定产生菌及其生物合成基因簇来验证。

papers.title: Cytoplasmic localization of 5hmC reveals RNA hydroxymethylation in breast cancer
papers.translated_title: 5hmC的细胞质定位揭示乳腺癌中的RNA羟甲基化
papers.author: Wen, J.
papers.summary: DNA methylation (5-methylcytosine, 5mC) is a major repressive epigenetic mark that can be iteratively oxidized by ten-eleven-translocation (TET) enzymes to 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC); beyond DNA, modifications of RNA can also affect transcript stability and processing, yet RNA hydroxymethylation remains unexplored in breast cancer (BC). Here, we identify a quantifiable cytoplasmic 5hmC signal in BC cell lines and, more prominently, in human BC tissue, using immunoassays and digital pathology, and confirm with an adapted, RNase-sensitive, RNA-specific ELISA that this signal reflects hydroxymethylation of total RNA and mRNA. Cytoplasmic 5hmC was significantly enriched in triple-negative (ER-/PR-/HER2-) and grade 3 tumors, and correlated with increased cytoplasmic TET2/TET3 in tissue and TET3 upregulation in TCGA. As a leading candidate mechanism, TET3 expression was associated with RNA-processing/spliceosomal transcripts, and TET3 knockdown in three TNBC cell lines reduced a subset of these targets, independently supported across 70 DepMap breast cancer lines.
papers.translated_summary: DNA甲基化（5-甲基胞嘧啶，5mC）是一种主要的抑制性表观遗传标记，可被十-十一易位（TET）酶迭代氧化为5-羟甲基胞嘧啶（5hmC）；除DNA外，RNA的修饰也可影响转录本稳定性和加工，然而RNA羟甲基化在乳腺癌（BC）中仍未被探索。在此，我们使用免疫测定和数字病理学在BC细胞系中鉴定出可量化的细胞质5hmC信号，并且在人BC组织中更为显著，并通过一种适应性、RNase敏感、RNA特异性的ELISA确认该信号反映了总RNA和mRNA的羟甲基化。细胞质5hmC在三阴性（ER-/PR-/HER2-）和3级肿瘤中显著富集，并与组织中细胞质TET2/TET3增加以及TCGA中TET3上调相关。作为一种主要候选机制，TET3表达与RNA加工/剪接体转录本相关，并且在三种TNBC细胞系中敲低TET3减少了这些靶标的一个子集，这一结果在70个DepMap乳腺癌细胞系中得到独立支持。

papers.title: Survivin Promotes the Formation of a Microtubule-Based Glycolytic Hub
papers.translated_title: Survivin促进基于微管的糖酵解中心的形成
papers.author: Neumann, J.
papers.summary: KRAS is one of the most frequently mutated oncoproteins in cancer. Its ability to induce malignant transformation relies on metabolic reprogramming that causes cells to become dependent on aerobic glycolysis as a primary source of energy and for generating biological building blocks. Thus far, the signaling mechanism used by oncogenic KRAS to promote these changes in cancer cell metabolism has not been fully elucidated. However, through studies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) cell lines and patient-derived organoids, we now demonstrate how oncogenic KRAS triggers an increase in glycolytic activity and identify Survivin as a newly discovered and critical KRAS-signaling partner essential for promoting these metabolic changes. We show that oncogenic KRAS potently upregulates the expression of Survivin in PDAC cells and patient-derived organoids undergoing increased glycolysis, whereas depleting Survivin expression inhibits their glycolytic activity and growth. Through a combination of cellular, biochemical, and imaging approaches, we further show that Survivin promotes the formation of unique microtubule-based structures that resemble invadosome rosettes, allowing for the recruitment of the glycolytic enzymes triose phosphate isomerase (TPI) and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) to these super-structures which drives the increases in glycolysis. These findings demonstrate that by directing the assembly of a microtubule-based complex of metabolic enzymes, Survivin serves as a vital link in a KRAS signaling pathway responsible for promoting the metabolic changes necessary for the accelerated growth of PDAC cells, and thus potentially highlight new therapeutic strategies for treating KRAS-dependent cancers.
papers.translated_summary: KRAS是癌症中最常发生突变的癌蛋白之一。其诱导恶性转化的能力依赖于代谢重编程，这种重编程使细胞变得依赖有氧糖酵解作为主要能量来源以及生成生物构建模块。迄今为止，致癌性KRAS促进癌细胞代谢这些变化所采用的信号传导机制尚未被完全阐明。然而，通过在胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）细胞系和患者来源类器官中的研究，我们现在证明了致癌性KRAS如何触发糖酵解活性的增加，并鉴定出Survivin作为一个新发现且关键的KRAS信号传导伙伴，对于促进这些代谢变化至关重要。我们表明，致癌性KRAS在糖酵解增加的PDAC细胞和患者来源类器官中强效上调Survivin的表达，而消耗Survivin表达则抑制其糖酵解活性和生长。通过结合细胞学、生物化学和成像方法，我们进一步表明，Survivin促进形成独特的基于微管的结构，这些结构类似于invadosome玫瑰花结，使得糖酵解酶磷酸丙糖异构酶（TPI）和甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶（GAPDH）被招募到这些超结构上，从而驱动糖酵解的增强。这些发现表明，通过指导基于微管的代谢酶复合物的组装，Survivin在一条KRAS信号通路中充当重要环节，该通路负责促进PDAC细胞加速生长所必需的代谢变化，因此可能突显了治疗KRAS依赖性癌症的新治疗策略。

papers.title: The interactome of the receptor kinase THESEUS1 reveals how cell wall integrity is linked to hormone signalling in Arabidopsis
papers.translated_title: 受体激酶THESEUS1的相互作用组揭示了拟南芥中细胞壁完整性与激素信号传导的联系
papers.author: Zwartkruis, S. T. W.
papers.summary: The receptor kinase THESEUS1 (THE1) activates responses to impairment of cell wall integrity (CWI). However, the interaction partners enabling THE1 to mediate the responses remain underexplored, impeding a mechanistic understanding of THE1. We produced a set of THE1 GFP fusion constructs in which THE1 is either wild type, mutated in its kinase domain, has a loss of function mutation in its ectodomain, or lacks the kinase or extracellular domain. We used these constructs to perform localization studies and immunoprecipitation liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry under control and stress conditions (isoxaben induced cell wall damage and sorbitol induced hyperosmotic stress) to identify the THE1 interactome. The interactome of THE1 changed in a context dependent manner, linking THE1 to known signaling components in CWI maintenance and phytohormone response (such as proton pumps, calcium pumps, other receptor kinases or cellulose synthesis regulators). Moreover, we identified novel interactors, associating THE1 with hitherto unexplored signaling pathways in response to CWI impairment. Our results also suggest that the THE1G37D protein (corresponding to the the1 1 allele) is retained in the endoplasmic reticulum, explaining its loss of function phenotype. The THE1 interactome and localization data provide the foundation to build a mechanistic understanding of THE1 mediated CWI maintenance.
papers.translated_summary: 受体激酶THESEUS1（THE1）激活对细胞壁完整性（CWI）受损的响应。然而，使THE1能够介导这些响应的相互作用伙伴仍未得到充分探索，阻碍了对THE1机制的理解。我们构建了一组THE1 GFP融合构建体，其中THE1为野生型、在其激酶结构域中突变、在其胞外域中具有功能丧失突变，或缺乏激酶或胞外结构域。我们使用这些构建体在对照和胁迫条件下（异恶草胺诱导的细胞壁损伤和山梨醇诱导的高渗胁迫）进行定位研究和免疫沉淀液相色谱串联质谱，以鉴定THE1相互作用组。THE1的相互作用组以情境依赖的方式发生变化，将THE1与CWI维持和植物激素响应中的已知信号组分（如质子泵、钙泵、其他受体激酶或纤维素合成调节因子）联系起来。此外，我们鉴定了新的相互作用因子，将THE1与响应CWI损伤的此前未探索的信号通路相关联。我们的结果还表明，THE1G37D蛋白（对应于the1 1等位基因）滞留于内质网中，解释了其功能丧失表型。THE1相互作用组和定位数据为建立对THE1介导的CWI维持的机制理解提供了基础。

papers.title: Drug Gene-Set Analysis Identifies Established and Emerging Therapeutic Mechanisms
papers.translated_title: 药物基因集分析识别出已确立和新兴的治疗机制
papers.author: Bell, N. Y.
papers.summary: Developing novel disease therapies is challenging, especially for central nervous system (CNS) disorders, which have a clinical approval rate of 6.2%. Genetic evidence is associated with higher success rates in drug development, but systematically translating genome-wide association study (GWAS) signals into actionable therapeutic hypotheses remains difficult. Here, we present DRUGSETS, a framework that tests whether drug (n = 8,136) and mechanism-of-action (MoA; n = 384) gene sets are enriched for GWAS associations. We applied DRUGSETS to five CNS and five non-CNS phenotypes using competitive gene-set analysis with both the standard MAGMA gene-level statistic and Polygenic Priority Scores (PoPS). Both implementations were enriched for approved treatments, and drug gene set significance was associated with further progression in clinical trials. Across all ten phenotypes, we identified 69 MoA and 589 drug gene set-associations that were study-wide significant, finding both established and novel pharmacological targets. Non-CNS traits were enriched for immune, hemostatic and metabolic mechanisms. Psychiatric disorders converged on mechanisms regulating neuronal excitation/inhibition, and Alzheimer's disease was enriched for immune-related mechanisms and amyloid aggregation. DRUGSETS identifies shared and disease-specific therapeutic biology, including mechanisms not targeted by current treatments. DRUGSETS is available as an open-source tool and is being integrated into FUMA.
papers.translated_summary: 开发新型疾病疗法具有挑战性，尤其是中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病，其临床批准率为6.2%。遗传证据与药物开发中更高的成功率相关，但系统地将全基因组关联研究（GWAS）信号转化为可操作的治疗假设仍然困难。在此，我们提出DRUGSETS，一个用于检验药物（n = 8,136）和作用机制（MoA；n = 384）基因集是否富集GWAS关联的框架。我们使用竞争性基因集分析，结合标准MAGMA基因水平统计量和多基因优先级评分（PoPS），将DRUGSETS应用于五种CNS表型和五种非CNS表型。两种实现均在已批准治疗中富集，且药物基因集显著性临床试验的进一步进展相关。在所有十种表型中，我们识别出69个MoA和589个药物基因集关联达到研究范围显著性，发现了既有和新的药理学靶点。非CNS性状富集于免疫、止血和代谢机制。精神疾病集中于调节神经元兴奋/抑制的机制，阿尔茨海默病富集于免疫相关机制和淀粉样蛋白聚集。DRUGSETS识别了共享和疾病特异性的治疗生物学，包括当前治疗未靶向的机制。DRUGSETS作为开源工具提供，并正在整合到FUMA中。

papers.title: Same-day hybrid capture workflow for diagnosis and surveillance of respiratory pathogens
papers.translated_title: 当日混合捕获流程用于呼吸道病原体的诊断与监测
papers.author: Buggiotti, L.
papers.summary: Hybrid capture approaches can detect a broad range of pathogens directly from clinical samples with greater sensitivity than untargeted approaches. Clinical adoption has been limited by long turnaround times, complex workflows, and perceived high costs. We iteratively developed and validated a rapid hybrid capture workflow based on Illumina's RPIP protocol (standard workflow). Rapid-RPIP v1 reduced wet-lab time from ~11.4 to ~7.3 h, for a turnaround time (TAT) of <15 h. Rapid-RPIP v2 further reduced wet-lab time by ~0.7 h and used Illumina Turbo Sequencing shortening the sequencing time from ~5.5 to ~2.5 h thus achieving a TAT of <10 h without compromising sensitivity and yielding higher RPKMs for RNA viruses than the standard workflow. This approach could be readily adapted to a broad range of clinical and public health applications.
papers.translated_summary: 杂交捕获方法可直接从临床样本中检测广谱病原体，灵敏度高于非靶向方法。临床采用一直受限于周转时间长、工作流程复杂以及被认为成本高昂。我们基于Illumina的RPIP方案（标准工作流程）迭代开发并验证了一种快速杂交捕获工作流程。Rapid-RPIP v1将湿实验时间从约11.4小时缩短至约7.3小时，周转时间（TAT）<15小时。Rapid-RPIP v2进一步将湿实验时间缩短约0.7小时，并使用Illumina Turbo测序将测序时间从约5.5小时缩短至约2.5小时，从而在不影响灵敏度的情况下实现<10小时的TAT，并且对RNA病毒产生的RPKM高于标准工作流程。该方法可 readily 适用于广泛的临床和公共卫生应用。

papers.title: Universal coordinate on wave-shape manifold of cardiovascular waveform signal for dynamic quantification and cross-subject comparison
papers.translated_title: 心血管波形信号波形流形上的通用坐标用于动态量化和跨受试者比较
papers.author: Wu, H.-T.
papers.summary: Objective: Quantifying physiological dynamics from nonstationary time series for clinical decision-making is challenging, especially when comparing data across different subjects. We propose a solution and validate it using two real-world surgical databases, focusing on underutilized arterial blood pressure (ABP) signals. Method: We apply a manifold learning algorithm, Dynamic Diffusion Maps (DDMap), combined with the novel Universal Coordinate (UC) algorithm to quantify dynamics from nonstationary time series. The method is demonstrated using ABP signal and validated with liver transplant and cardiovascular surgery databases, both containing clinical outcomes. Sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess robustness and identify optimal parameters. Results: UC application is validated by significant correlations between the derived index and clinical outcomes. Sensitivity analyses confirm the algorithms stability and help optimize parameters. Conclusions: DDMap combined with UC enables dynamic quantification of ABP signals and comparison across subjects. This technique repurposes typically discarded ABP signals in the operating room, with potential applications to other nonstationary biomedical signals in both hospital and homecare settings.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：从非平稳时间序列中量化生理动力学以支持临床决策具有挑战性，尤其是在比较不同受试者的数据时。我们提出一种解决方案，并使用两个真实手术数据库进行验证，重点关注未被充分利用的动脉血压（ABP）信号。方法：我们应用流形学习算法动态扩散映射（DDMap），结合新颖的通用坐标（UC）算法，从非平稳时间序列中量化动力学。该方法使用ABP信号进行演示，并通过肝移植和心血管手术数据库进行验证，两者均包含临床结局。进行了敏感性分析以评估稳健性并确定最佳参数。结果：UC应用通过衍生指标与临床结局之间的显著相关性得到验证。敏感性分析确认了算法的稳定性并有助于优化参数。结论：DDMap结合UC能够实现ABP信号的动态量化及跨受试者比较。该技术重新利用了手术室中通常被丢弃的ABP信号，在医院和家庭护理环境中对其他非平稳生物医学信号具有潜在应用价值。

papers.title: A quantitative approach to evidence triangulation: development of a framework to address rigour and relevance
papers.translated_title: 证据三角互证的定量方法：构建一个兼顾严谨性与相关性的框架
papers.author: Shapland, C. Y.
papers.summary: Triangulation is an approach to strengthen causal inference by integrating evidence from multiple sources. Most studies using triangulation have qualitatively examined whether different studies agree upon the presence of a causal effect, rather than estimated the effect by quantitatively integrating results. Here, we develop a framework for quantitative triangulation. We first address how to relate study specific research questions to an overall target causal question (relevance) and then assess the directions and magnitudes of bias in each study (rigour), before combining the results using meta-analysis adjusted for the biases. We illustrate our framework by triangulating evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs), Mendelian randomization (MR) and conventional multivariable regression (MVR) to estimate the effect of beta-carotene on coronary heart disease (CHD) and cardiovascular disease (CVD). Five RCTs and one MR study showed little evidence of a causal relationship between beta-carotene and CHD (relative risk (RR)=1.00 with 95% CI=0.98 to 1.01 and RR=1.02 with 95% CI=0.98 to 1.07, respectively). Thirteen MVR studies indicated that high intake of beta-carotene reduces CHD risk (RR=0.83 with 95% CI=0.76 to 0.91). After applying our framework, the three study designs agreed that there is no strong evidence against the null hypothesis that beta-carotene intake does not affect risk of CHD (RR=0.99 with 95% CI=0.82 to 1.21). Findings were similar for CVD. Our framework shows how to address rigour and relevance quantitatively when triangulating evidence from different study designs. We highlight the importance of explicitly defining the target and study-specific research questions. papers.translated_summary: 三角互证是一种通过整合多来源证据来强化因果推断的方法。多数使用三角互证的研究仅定性考察不同研究是否在因果效应的存在性上一致，而非通过定量整合结果来估计效应。在此，我们开发了一个定量三角互证的框架。我们首先处理如何将各研究特定研究问题与总体目标因果问题相关联（相关性），然后评估每项研究中偏倚的方向和幅度（严谨性），之后在调整偏倚的荟萃分析中合并结果。我们通过三角互证随机对照试验、孟德尔随机化和传统多变量回归的证据来估计β-胡萝卜素对冠心病和心血管疾病的影响，以说明我们的框架。五项随机对照试验和一项孟德尔随机化研究几乎未显示β-胡萝卜素与冠心病之间存在因果关系的证据（相对风险分别为1.00，95%置信区间0.98至1.01；以及1.02，95%置信区间0.98至1.07）。十三项多变量回归研究表明，高摄入β-胡萝卜素可降低冠心病风险（相对风险0.83，95%置信区间0.76至0.91）。应用我们的框架后，三种研究设计一致认为，没有强有力的证据反对β-胡萝卜素摄入不影响冠心病风险的零假设（相对风险0.99，95%置信区间0.82至1.21）。心血管疾病的研究结果类似。我们的框架展示了在三角互证不同研究设计的证据时，如何定量处理严谨性和相关性问题。我们强调了明确定义目标研究问题和各研究特定研究问题的重要性。我们的框架展示了在三角互证不同研究设计的证据时，如何定量处理严谨性和相关性问题。我们强调了明确定义目标研究问题和各研究特定研究问题的重要性。

papers.title: Three Cerebellar Imaging Subtypes in Schizophrenia with Distinct Spatiotemporal Trajectories and Biological Characteristics
papers.translated_title: 精神分裂症中具有不同时空轨迹和生物学特征的三类小脑影像亚型
papers.author: Liu, Z.
papers.summary: The potential role of the cerebellum in the pathophysiology of schizophrenia has received relatively insufficient attention. Prior studies characterized cerebellar abnormalities mainly at the group level, without fully considering the heterogeneity of the disease. Here, we applied a machine learning approach (Subtype and Stage Inference, SuStaIn) to cross-sectional 3D volumetric MRIs of the cerebellum, including a total of 3,550 individuals with schizophrenia (1423 females; mean age: 32.3 +/- 12.0 years) and 5,771 healthy controls (HC) (2,861 females; mean age: 32.5 +/- 12.9 years), from 34 sites worldwide. SuStaIn identified three distinct spatiotemporal trajectories in cerebellar gray matter volume reduction, respectively originating in lobule X (subtype 1), lobule III (subtype 2) and lobule VIIb (subtype 3), with subtypes 1 and 3 corresponding to the posterior lobe and subtype 2 to the anterior lobe. These trajectories were cross-sectionally inferred in 1,588 individuals with schizophrenia and replicated in another independent samples of 1,334 and 628 patients, respectively. Multimodal analyses using neuroimaging, transcriptomic and behavioral data revealed subtype-specific biological characteristics in brain morphological patterns, cerebellar-cortical connectivity, gene expression and clinical symptoms. Specifically, subtype-related genes were enriched in metabolism-related processes and immunity-related processes, respectively, in subtype 1 and subtype 2; subtype 3 showed more severe brain abnormalities and worse cognitive symptoms. Treatment data from 381 patients, with up to 12 months of follow-up, revealed poorer response to antipsychotic medications in subtype 2 and subtype 3, but better response to transcranial magnetic stimulation in subtype 1, which also had worse emotion-related symptoms. Together, our findings offer a comprehensive characterization of the heterogeneity of cerebellar pathophysiological progresses in schizophrenia, which may help in developing future clinical stratification and targeted intervention strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 小脑在精神分裂症病理生理学中的潜在作用相对而言未得到足够关注。既往研究主要在组水平上刻画小脑异常，未充分考虑疾病的异质性。本研究采用机器学习方法（亚型与分期推断，SuStaIn）对横断面小脑三维容积MRI进行分析，纳入来自全球34个中心的3,550例精神分裂症患者（1,423例女性；平均年龄：32.3 +/- 12.0岁）和5,771名健康对照（HC）（2,861例女性；平均年龄：32.5 +/- 12.9岁）。SuStaIn识别出小脑灰质体积减少的三种不同时空轨迹，分别起源于小叶X（亚型1）、小叶III（亚型2）和小叶VIIb（亚型3），其中亚型1和亚型3对应后叶，亚型2对应前叶。这些轨迹在1,588例精神分裂症患者中被横断面推断，并分别在另外1,334例和628例患者的独立样本中得到重复验证。利用神经影像、转录组和行为数据的多模态分析揭示了亚型特异性的生物学特征，涉及脑形态模式、小脑-皮层连接、基因表达和临床症状。具体而言，亚型相关基因在亚型1和亚型2中分别富集于代谢相关过程和免疫相关过程；亚型3表现出更严重的脑异常和更差的认知症状。来自381例患者、随访长达12个月的治疗数据显示，亚型2和亚型3对抗精神病药物治疗的反应较差，而亚型1对经颅磁刺激的反应较好，且其情绪相关症状更差。综上，本研究对小脑在精神分裂症中病理生理进展的异质性提供了全面刻画，可能有助于未来制定临床分层和靶向干预策略。

papers.title: EEG Biomarkers for Rett Syndrome: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning with Explainable AI
papers.translated_title: Rett综合征的EEG生物标志物：机器学习与深度学习及可解释AI的比较分析
papers.author: Gupta, M.
papers.summary: Rett syndrome (RTT) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by abnormal cortical activity, which can be captured using electroencephalography (EEG). Although machine learning (ML) has shown promise for diagnosing several neurological conditions, comprehensive evaluation of classical ML and deep learning (DL) methods, together with physiologically meaningful explanations, remains limited for RTT. This study analyses resting-state, eyes-closed EEG recordings from RTT patients and healthy controls using both power spectral density (PSD)-based ML and end-to-end DL frameworks. Classical ML models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were trained on PSD features, while EEG-specific DL architectures, including ShallowConvNet, DeepConvNet, EEGNet, and EEG Conformer, were trained directly on preprocessed EEG signals. Subject-wise cross-validation was used to avoid data leakage, with balanced accuracy as the primary performance metric because it equally accounts for sensitivity and specificity. Random Forest achieved the best performance among the classical ML models, whereas EEGNet achieved the highest DL performance. An ablation study indicated that 4-second EEG epochs offered the optimal trade-off between model performance and robustness. Model interpretability was investigated using SHAP for Random Forest and occlusion sensitivity analysis for EEGNet. Both methods consistently identified delta and theta oscillations, along with centro-frontal brain regions, as key contributors to RTT classification. These findings show that both PSD-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning methods can reliably identify RTT and highlight common neurophysiological biomarkers, offering an interpretable framework for EEG-based diagnosis and biomarker discovery for Rett Syndrome.
papers.translated_summary: Rett综合征（RTT）是一种罕见的神经发育障碍，其特征是皮层活动异常，可通过脑电图（EEG）捕捉。尽管机器学习（ML）在诊断多种神经系统疾病方面已显示出前景，但针对RTT的经典机器学习与深度学习（DL）方法的综合评估，以及具有生理学意义的解释，仍然有限。本研究使用基于功率谱密度（PSD）的机器学习和端到端深度学习框架，分析了RTT患者和健康对照者的静息态闭眼脑电图记录。经典机器学习模型，包括支持向量机、随机森林和XGBoost，在PSD特征上进行训练，而脑电图专用的深度学习架构，包括ShallowConvNet、DeepConvNet、EEGNet和EEG Conformer，则直接在预处理后的脑电信号上进行训练。采用按受试者划分的交叉验证以避免数据泄漏，并以平衡准确率作为主要性能指标，因为它同等考虑敏感性和特异性。随机森林在经典机器学习模型中取得了最佳性能，而EEGNet取得了最高的深度学习性能。消融研究表明，4秒的脑电片段在模型性能与稳健性之间提供了最佳权衡。模型可解释性通过随机森林的SHAP和EEGNet的遮挡敏感性分析进行研究。两种方法一致地将delta和theta振荡以及中央-额叶脑区识别为RTT分类的关键贡献因素。这些发现表明，基于PSD的机器学习和端到端深度学习方法均能可靠地识别RTT，并揭示了共同的神经生理生物标志物，为基于脑电图的Rett综合征诊断和生物标志物发现提供了一个可解释的框架。

papers.title: Working from home a few times a month to a few times a week is associated with higher psychological distress: between- and within-person analyses of a five-wave panel of employees in Japan
papers.translated_title: 每月居家办公几次到每周居家办公几次与更高的心理困扰相关：基于日本员工五波面板数据的个体间与个体内分析
papers.author: Fuse, S.-i.
papers.summary: Purpose To estimate the association between the frequency of working from home (WFH) and psychological distress among employees in Japan, separating between-person from within-person differences, and to examine this association by sex and household circumstances. Methods We used five annual waves (2021-2025) of the nationwide Japan COVID-19 and Society Internet Survey (JACSIS), including 39,773 employees aged [≥] 18 years who worked in the past month (78,498 person-waves). The exposure was the frequency of WFH in the past month (seven categories). The outcomes were the Kessler 6 (K6) score (0-24), K6 [≥] 5, and K6 [≥] 13. We used within-between linear regression, overall and by sex and household circumstances at the first wave. Results Compared with no WFH, WFH 2-3 times a month, once a week, and 2-3 times a week was associated with K6 scores higher by 1.99, 1.80, and 0.67 points between persons and by 0.53 (95% CI 0.28, 0.77), 0.45 (0.20, 0.69), and 0.35 (0.10, 0.60) points within persons, and with a 3.5-4.6 percentage point higher probability of K6 [≥] 5 within persons. These within-person K6 differences were positive in all sex and household groups (0.20-0.63 points) but imprecise. For the other frequencies, the within-person differences were 0.03-0.20 points. Conclusion WFH 2-3 times a month or once a week, and also 2-3 times a week, was associated with higher psychological distress, both between and within persons. Support for employees who sometimes work from home should consider the frequency of WFH together with their work and family situations.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 估计日本员工居家办公（WFH）频率与心理困扰之间的关联，区分个体间差异与个体内差异，并按性别和家庭状况检验该关联。方法 我们使用了全国性日本COVID-19与社会互联网调查（JACSIS）的五个年度波次（2021-2025年），纳入39,773名年龄≥18岁且在过去一个月内工作过的员工（78,498人-波次）。暴露变量为过去一个月内居家办公的频率（七个类别）。结局变量为Kessler 6（K6）评分（0-24）、K6≥5和K6≥13。我们采用个体内-个体间线性回归，分别进行总体分析以及按第一波次的性别和家庭状况分层分析。结果 与不居家办公相比，每月居家办公2-3次、每周一次和每周2-3次与K6评分在个体间分别高出1.99、1.80和0.67分相关，在个体内分别高出0.53（95% CI 0.28, 0.77）、0.45（0.20, 0.69）和0.35（0.10, 0.60）分相关，并与个体内K6≥5的概率高出3.5-4.6个百分点相关。这些个体内K6差异在所有性别和家庭组中均为正值（0.20-0.63分），但估计不精确。对于其他频率，个体内差异为0.03-0.20分。结论 每月居家办公2-3次或每周一次，以及每周2-3次，与更高的心理困扰相关，无论在个体间还是个体内均如此。对有时居家办公的员工的支持应综合考虑居家办公频率及其工作和家庭状况。

papers.title: Source-water salinity measured by electrical conductivity in Bangladesh, 2025: a nationally representative cross-sectional survey
papers.translated_title: 2025年孟加拉国以电导率测量的水源盐度：一项具有全国代表性的横断面调查
papers.author: Hoque, S. M. A. U.
papers.summary: BackgroundIn coastal Bangladesh, saline drinking water has been linked to raised blood pressure. The 2025 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) measured electrical conductivity (EC), a salinity indicator, in source water, but its report gave no population counts or district estimates. ObjectivesTo estimate how many people live in households whose tested source has high EC, and to describe patterns by place, household characteristics, source type and arsenic. MethodsEC was measured in source water of 6,040 households in 64 districts, February to June. In 14.5% of households the tested source was not the main drinking-water source. Primary outcomes were EC above 1,500 and 3,000 {micro}S/cm, survey risk classes that are not health-based standards. Estimates were survey weighted; comparisons were observational. ResultsEC exceeded 1,500 {micro}S/cm in 5.3% of households (95% CI 4.7 to 5.9), about 9.0 million people, including 1.8 million above 3,000 {micro}S/cm. Coastal-zone districts held 26% of households but 70% of those above 1,500 {micro}S/cm. Shares varied little by wealth or in households with young children or pregnant women. Nationally, deep tube wells more often had high EC because most are coastal. In the coastal zone, deep and shallow wells had similar shares (16.1% and 17.9%). After district adjustment, EC was about 18% lower in deep wells (geometric mean ratio 0.82, 0.73 to 0.92). Within upazilas (restricted sample) it was 0.93 (0.80 to 1.07). Arsenic above 10 ppb was more common where EC was high, but this link weakened after district adjustment. ConclusionsMillions of people live in households whose tested source has high EC, mostly in coastal and south-central districts. Deep wells had modestly lower EC after geographic adjustment, but the difference shrank within upazilas and depended on the handling of implausibly low readings. The findings support measuring EC alongside arsenic, with documented meter calibration.
papers.translated_summary: 背景在孟加拉国沿海地区，咸化饮用水与血压升高有关。2025年多指标类集调查（MICS）测量了水源水的电导率（EC），这是盐度的一项指标，但其报告未给出人口数量或地区估计。目标估算有多少人居住在所检测水源EC较高的家庭中，并按地点、家庭特征、水源类型和砷含量描述其分布模式。方法于2月至6月在64个地区的6，040户家庭的水源水中测量EC。在14.5%的家庭中，所检测水源并非主要饮用水源。主要结局为EC高于1，500和3，000微西门子/厘米，这是调查风险分类，并非基于健康的标准。估计值经调查加权；比较为观察性。结果5.3%的家庭EC超过1，500微西门子/厘米（95% CI 4.7至5.9），约900万人，其中180万人超过3，000微西门子/厘米。沿海地区各区占家庭总数的26%，但在EC超过1，500微西门子/厘米的家庭中占70%。不同财富水平以及有幼儿或孕妇的家庭中，这一比例差异不大。在全国范围内，深管井更常有高EC，因为大多数位于沿海。在沿海地区，深井和浅井的比例相似（16.1%和17.9%）。经地区调整后，深井的EC约低18%（几何均值比0.82，0.73至0.92）。在乌帕齐拉内（受限样本）为0.93（0.80至1.07）。砷高于10 ppb的情况在EC高之处更常见，但这一关联在地区调整后减弱。结论数百万人居住在所检测水源EC较高的家庭中，主要位于沿海和中南部地区。经地理调整后，深井的EC略低，但差异在乌帕齐拉内缩小，并取决于对不合理低读数的处理。研究结果支持在测量砷的同时测量EC，并记录仪器校准情况。

papers.title: Insomnia and the genetic overlap of sleep with depression and anxiety: a genomic structural equation modelling study
papers.translated_title: 失眠与睡眠和抑郁及焦虑的遗传重叠：一项基因组结构方程模型研究
papers.author: Sakiroglu, M. A.
papers.summary: Insomnia, depression and anxiety co-occur and share genetic liability, but a genetic correlation cannot show whether that liability is spread across the sleep domain or concentrated in insomnia, a diagnostic criterion for depression and generalized anxiety disorder. We applied genomic structural equation modelling to ten genome-wide association studies and fitted a four-factor model of sleep, internalizing (depression and anxiety), psychotic-bipolar and metabolic liability. A model linking the sleep and internalizing domains only through their factor correlation was inadmissible, and we compared, under one decision rule, each one-parameter link that could repair it: domain-wide links, an insomnia-specific cross-loading, and residual covariances representing shared diagnostic content, of which three were admissible. The insomnia cross-loading fitted better than the only admissible domain-wide alternative ({Delta}AIC = 13.8; better in 98.6% of 500 Monte Carlo draws) and than shared content ({Delta}AIC = 96.9), and placing it on psychotic-bipolar or metabolic liability was inadmissible. Under this model the insomnia pathway carried 56.3% of the sleep-internalizing covariance (95% CI 45.6-67.0%). A second sleep pathway improved fit ({Delta}AIC = -33.3), but with three sleep indicators its location was not identifiable, and across the equivalent models the insomnia share ranged from 0% to 127.0%. At the variant level, no internalizing lead departed from depression-anxiety proportionality after correction, and internalizing leads replicated in FinnGen, with partial sample overlap, whereas sleep leads did not (60.4%; P = 0.17). How concentrated the overlap is will require finer sleep phenotypes to establish. Among single-link models, insomnia is the best-supported location of the overlap.
papers.translated_summary: 失眠、抑郁和焦虑共同发生并共享遗传易感性，但遗传相关无法表明该易感性是分布在整个睡眠领域，还是集中于失眠——失眠是抑郁和广泛性焦虑障碍的一项诊断标准。我们对十项全基因组关联研究应用了基因组结构方程模型，拟合了一个包含睡眠、内化（抑郁和焦虑）、精神病-双相和代谢易感性的四因子模型。仅通过因子相关连接睡眠和内化领域的模型不可接受，我们在同一决策规则下比较了每种可修复该模型的一参数连接：领域-wide连接、失眠特异性交叉载荷，以及代表共享诊断内容的残差协方差，其中三种可接受。失眠交叉载荷的拟合优于唯一可接受的领域-wide替代方案（{Delta}AIC = 13.8；在500次蒙特卡洛抽样中98.6%更优），也优于共享内容（{Delta}AIC = 96.9），而将其置于精神病-双相或代谢易感性上则不可接受。在该模型下，失眠通路承载了56.3%的睡眠-内化协方差（95% CI 45.6-67.0%）。第二条睡眠通路改善了拟合（{Delta}AIC = -33.3），但在三个睡眠指标下其位置无法识别，且在等效模型间失眠占比范围为0%至127.0%。在变异水平上，校正后没有内化先导变异偏离抑郁-焦虑比例性，内化先导变异在FinnGen中重复，存在部分样本重叠，而睡眠先导变异则未重复（60.4%；P = 0.17）。重叠的集中程度需要更精细的睡眠表型来确定。在单连接模型中，失眠是重叠位置的最佳支持。

papers.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists (GLP-1RAs) for treatment of tobacco and alcohol dependence: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）治疗烟草和酒精依赖：随机对照试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Taylor, G.
papers.summary: Background Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) might reduce tobacco and alcohol use. We synthesised evidence from randomised controlled trials (RCTs) on smoking and alcohol outcomes, including secondary outcomes reported in trials conducted for other clinical purposes. Methods We searched MEDLINE, Embase, PsycINFO, Web of Science, CENTRAL, PubMed, and registries for RCTs comparing GLP-1RAs with placebo from inception to August 18, 2026. Smoking and alcohol outcomes were synthesised using random-effects meta-analyses. We assessed risk of bias (RoB) with RoB-2, and certainty of evidence with the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. Findings Fourteen trials involving 1149 participants were included; 13 contributed to meta-analyses. Across the 14 trials, 8 recruited participants not seeking either tobacco or alcohol treatment. The other 6 recruited treatment-seeking participants: 3 for tobacco and 3 for alcohol. Eight trials reported smoking-related outcomes, 11 reported alcohol outcomes, and 5 reported both. Follow-up ranged from 6 to 60 weeks. All 4 pooled smoking-related estimates favoured GLP-1RAs, although all 95% CIs included no difference and were compatible with increases and decreases in outcomes; e.g., smoking cessation, OR 1.39 (95% CI, 0.77 to 2.53, k=3). Restricting analyses to semaglutide trials indicated a reduction in cigarettes per day (CPD) (SMD=-0.10, 95%CI:-0.16 to -0.04; k=3). Across agents, pooled estimates favoured GLP-1RAs for days without alcohol (SMD=0.35, 95%CI: 0.12 to 0.59, k=3). Pooled estimates of semaglutide-only trials also favoured treatment for alcohol consumption (grams/day; SMD=-0.56, 95%CI:-0.82 to -0.30; k=2), craving (SMD=-0.60, 95%CI:-0.91 to -0.29; k=2), drinks per drinking day (SMD=-0.59, 95%CI:-0.86 to -0.32; k=3), drinks per calendar day (SMD=-0.48, 95%CI:-0.87 to -0.09; k=2) and heavy drinking days (SMD=-0.45, 95%CI:-0.85 to -0.06; k=3), and alcohol-free days (SMD=0.41, 95%CI:0.09 to 0.73; k=2). Two of 41 assessed results were at low RoB, 31 raised some concerns and 8 were at high risk; certainty was moderate for 1 outcome, low for 4 and very low for 8. Interpretation GLP-1RAs may reduce alcohol consumption and CPD, with the clearest evidence for semaglutide. These findings should be contextualised by most evidence being low- to very-low-certainty. Larger trials are needed to establish clinically meaningful benefit and sustained abstinence.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）可能减少烟草和酒精使用。我们综合了随机对照试验（RCT）中关于吸烟和酒精结局的证据，包括为其他临床目的开展的试验中报告的次要结局。方法 我们检索了MEDLINE、Embase、PsycINFO、Web of Science、CENTRAL、PubMed以及注册库，纳入从建库至2026年8月18日比较GLP-1RAs与安慰剂的RCT。吸烟和酒精结局采用随机效应荟萃分析进行综合。我们使用RoB-2评估偏倚风险（RoB），并使用推荐意见分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法评估证据确定性。结果 共纳入14项试验，涉及1149名参与者；其中13项纳入荟萃分析。在14项试验中，8项招募的参与者未寻求烟草或酒精治疗。其余6项招募了寻求治疗的参与者：3项针对烟草，3项针对酒精。8项试验报告了吸烟相关结局，11项报告了酒精结局，5项同时报告两者。随访时间为6至60周。所有4项吸烟相关合并估计均倾向于GLP-1RAs，尽管所有95%CI均包含无差异，且与结局的升高和降低均相容；例如，戒烟，OR 1.39（95%CI，0.77至2.53，k=3）。将分析限制于司美格鲁肽试验显示每日吸烟支数（CPD）减少（SMD=-0.10，95%CI：-0.16至-0.04；k=3）。跨药物汇总，合并估计倾向于GLP-1RAs对无酒精天数的改善（SMD=0.35，95%CI：0.12至0.59，k=3）。仅司美格鲁肽试验的合并估计也倾向于治疗对酒精消耗量（克/天；SMD=-0.56，95%CI：-0.82至-0.30；k=2）、渴求（SMD=-0.60，95%CI：-0.91至-0.29；k=2）、每个饮酒日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.59，95%CI：-0.86至-0.32；k=3）、每个日历日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.48，95%CI：-0.87至-0.09；k=2）和重度饮酒天数（SMD=-0.45，95%CI：-0.85至-0.06；k=3）以及无酒精天数（SMD=0.41，95%CI：0.09至0.73；k=2）的改善。在41项评估结果中，2项为低偏倚风险，31项存在一些担忧，8项为高偏倚风险；1项结局的证据确定性为中等，4项为低，8项为极低。解释 GLP-1RAs可能减少酒精消耗和CPD，其中司美格鲁肽的证据最为明确。这些发现应结合大多数证据为低至极低确定性这一背景来理解。需要更大规模的试验来确定具有临床意义的获益和持续戒断。
